evaluation_contract.warmup_use: past-only feature initialization; no setup, intent, position, PnL, or metric before evaluation start
evaluation_contract.entry_knowledge: close-confirmed state transition, fill at following one-minute open
evaluation_contract.global_constraint: at most one selected entry intent or one open position across all scenarios

shared_confirmation.liquidity_pool: rolling high/low shifted by one bar
shared_confirmation.sweep: pool penetration and close back inside, adverse taker-flow imbalance, relative-volume and wick evidence
shared_confirmation.confirmation: close through fixed pre-sweep structure, directional body >= 0.4 ATR, directional 15-minute taker-flow improvement >= 0.03, directional close location >= 0.50

scenarios.name: EXTERNAL_REVERSAL
scenarios.state: external liquidity sweep and failed auction
scenarios.suppression: when side-adjusted four-hour return is below the negative past-only rolling 80th percentile of absolute four-hour return, convert confirmation to a monitored cascade-failure probe

scenarios.name: CASCADE_REVERSAL_FAILURE
scenarios.trigger: close beyond sweep extreme in prior trend direction with directional body >= 3 ATR, aligned 15-minute flow and directional close location >= 0.50
scenarios.stop: opposite post-sweep/probe extreme plus 0.08 sweep ATR

scenarios.name: INTERNAL_TREND_RESUMPTION
scenarios.state: side-adjusted four-hour displacement >= 0 and side-adjusted one-hour displacement < 0 at the sweep; local liquidity is taken during a pullback inside a longer trend

scenarios.name: DECELERATED_CASCADE_EXHAUSTION
scenarios.state: one-hour, four-hour, twelve-hour and twenty-four-hour displacement all oppose the reversal, but absolute twelve-hour displacement is at most half absolute twenty-four-hour displacement

scenarios.name: MULTISCALE_TREND_CONSENSUS
scenarios.state: UTC-day, one-hour, four-hour, twelve-hour and twenty-four-hour displacement all agree with the reclaimed sweep direction

scenarios.name: MICRO_DISLOCATION_RESUMPTION
scenarios.impact: pool penetration ATR divided by sweep volume / lagged rolling median volume
scenarios.auction_efficiency: absolute one-hour net move divided by one-hour absolute path length
scenarios.trend_state: four-hour displacement agrees with entry, or twelve-hour displacement agrees while six-hour displacement is a pullback
scenarios.cascade_guard: side-adjusted four-hour return must not be below the negative past-only rolling 80th percentile of absolute four-hour return

execution_and_risk.quantity_denominator: absolute adverse entry-to-stop fill distance + entry fee + stop fee + planned adverse funding

known_development_limit: dev-3 and dev-5 have only two independent parent events; untouched validation must confirm both state coverage and growth
